Two volunteer firefighters were assaulted by residents while responding to a fire in Barangay 650, Port Area, Manila, on Friday afternoon.

“Binugbog po ako dahil naghihintay po ako ng tubig dahil gawa ng wala pang supply kasi hinihintay ‘yung supply. Ngayon, wala raw tubig. ‘Yun binugbog na nila ako,” one of the volunteers said.

The volunteers will file charges against the perpetrators.
